How it works

No keyboard. No voice.
No screen between you and the film.

[1]

Think it

A quiet line of titanium at the neck reads the muscle signals of the words you say silently. You stay in the moment — no phone in your hand.

[2]

It writes

Your silent words become a screenplay in proper format: scene headings, action, dialogue. You stay the director — accept, reshape, rewrite in your head.

[3]

It speaks

Every character gets a voice. Hear the dialogue the moment you think it, and hear what doesn’t work before an actor ever does.

[4]

It shows

Scenes turn into storyboards and 3D animatics — the world you imagined, ready to walk through and to pitch.

4×
Faster than typing — silent speech runs at ~150 words a minute

Founder

Ann Fedotova

Founder & CEO

I started working at 11 and earned my first income from what I loved and what was only beginning to grow: SMM, social media, community, design. Later came marketing and building products. Every day I watched and analyzed how people make choices, make mistakes, and how contact between people breaks down. That led me to study behavioral psychology, psychosomatics and cognitive psychology, and it is the reason I am building this product. When we think unconsciously, our muscles move, and our unconscious builds our reality every day. In a world where AI automates more and more processes, what remains for a person is the essential: their thought and real contact with others. VOIZEX removes the seam between thought and action and helps people enjoy reality.
